nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 collateral token address held by CollateralLocker and transferred out in pull().
Immutable address of the Loan contract authorized to call pull(); used by the isLoan modifier.
CollateralLocker constructor; sets collateralAsset and loan from arguments.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == loan, enforcing access control over pull().
External isLoan-guarded function transferring amt of collateralAsset to dst via safeTransfer.
Caller-supplied address compared against loan in the isLoan modifier.
External token transfer collateralAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) performing a low-level call to the ERC20 token.
Library helper executing the encoded ERC20 call via Address.functionCall and decoding the result.
Library helper performing a checked low-level call to the target contract with supplied data.
target.call{value:value}(data) low-level external call in Address.functionCallWithValue, transferring control to the token contract.
Constructor parameter for the collateral token address.
Constructor parameter for the authorized Loan address.
pull() parameter: destination address for the collateral transfer.
pull() parameter: amount of collateral asset to transfer.
functionCall parameter: address the low-level call is sent to.
functionCall parameter: calldata forwarded to the low-level call.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _collateralAsset is converted to IERC20 and stored.
Constructor parameter _loan is stored in the loan state variable.
Constructor writes the collateralAsset state variable.
Constructor writes the loan state variable.
msg.sender is read and validated inside the isLoan modifier.
loan state variable is compared against msg.sender in the authorization check.
isLoan modifier gates entry into pull(), restricting callers to the Loan.
dst parameter flows into the pull() transfer destination.
amt parameter flows into the pull() transfer amount.
pull() invokes the external safeTransfer operation on the collateral token.
safeTransfer is executed on the collateralAsset token instance.
safeTransfer call resolves into the SafeERC20.safeTransfer library function.
safeTransfer forwards the encoded call to _callOptionalReturn.
_callOptionalReturn invokes Address.functionCall on the token address.
target address parameter flows into the low-level functionCall.
calldata parameter flows into the low-level functionCall.
functionCallWithValue executes the low-level external call with value and data.
The external token call transfers control to an untrusted contract which may re-enter pull() before state effects settle.
